Why UAE Brands Manufacture with FABRIOZA

  • 50-piece MOQ: launch or test a style without committing to a container. Most factories serving the UAE demand 300–500 pieces per design.
  • Factory-direct pricing: we are the factory in Sialkot, Pakistan — no trading company margin. Typical savings vs regional production run 30–50%.
  • Verified standards: export-grade quality management and a documented 4-stage QC process with photo records — the audit trail UAE retailers ask for.
  • English-first communication with near-total working-hours overlap, quotes inside 24 hours, and one point of contact from sample to delivery.

What We Manufacture for UAE Brands

Team uniforms & sportswear (16 categories), streetwear (heavyweight tees, oversized hoodies, cargo), medical scrubs, kidswear, plus size, menswear, intimate apparel and sustainable/eco garments — all fully private-labeled under your brand. See everything we make.

How It Works

  1. Send your design — tech pack, sketch or reference image. Design mockup within 24–48 hours.
  2. Approve your sample — produced in 5–7 days, shipped to your door in UAE.
  3. Bulk production — 2–4 weeks with 4-stage QC (fabric inspection, in-line checks, AQL 2.5 sampling, photo documentation).
  4. DDP delivery — we handle export, freight and UAE customs (5%); you receive sealed cartons ready to sell.

FAQ: Manufacturing for UAE Brands

How fast can you deliver to Dubai?

Express courier reaches the UAE in 2-4 business days - the fastest lane we serve. A full cycle from design to delivered goods can run under 4 weeks.

Do you manufacture modest fashion?

Yes - kaftans, abaya-style layers, maxi dresses, co-ord sets and loose-fit athleisure are core categories, with digital print and embroidery options.

Do you handle UAE customs?

Yes - DDP shipping includes the 5% GCC customs duty and clearance paperwork for the UAE and wider Gulf.

Can you produce staff uniforms for companies in the Gulf?

Yes - corporate, hospitality, gym-staff and delivery uniforms with embroidered branding, from 50 pieces per style with repeat-order consistency.

What payment methods do you accept?

Bank transfer, credit card and PayPal, in USD, EUR, GBP, AUD or CAD - with a standard 50% deposit / 50% before shipment structure.
